claims.claim: Bent office chair available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report describes an office swivel chair with wear/creasing but does not show or confirm bending/damage.
Witness report shows chair type and visible wear; no purchase date/receipt/label shown.
Witness report notes light wear/creasing and no obvious tears from the shown angle, but does not confirm absence of stains or check all sides/underside.
Witness report does not include a sit/press test or foam condition check.
Witness report does not include smell/odor verification.

risks.risk: Gas lift may be weak/leaking or the chair may not hold height properly.
risks.proof: A short clip showing the chair being raised and lowered repeatedly, then staying at a set height without sinking.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially not holding height (worst-case: needs repair/low usability).

risks.risk: Tilt/recline/locking mechanism may not work or may be loose.
risks.proof: A clip demonstrating recline/tilt and engaging/disengaging any lock, showing it holds position.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the adjustment/locking may be faulty.

risks.risk: Base/frame may have hidden cracks, bent metal, or loose screws under the seat.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the underside of the seat and the base/frame joints (all around), plus a quick shake test showing no wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if there could be structural issues (worst-case: reduced lifespan).

risks.risk: Wheels may not roll smoothly or may have damage; brakes (if present) may fail.
risks.proof: A clip rolling the chair across the floor in a straight line and turning, plus testing any wheel brakes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if wheels/brakes may be unreliable.

risks.risk: Upholstery may have stains/odors not visible from the angle, or fabric may be more worn than shown.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides (front/back/left/right) and close-ups of seams, plus a smell/odor check confirmation by the buyer.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible cosmetic issues (worst-case: stains/dirty fabric).

risks.risk: Armrests may be damaged or not adjustable (height/angle), affecting comfort and value.
risks.proof: A clip showing armrest adjustment (if adjustable) and a close-up of both armrests for cracks/looseness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-adjustable or potentially worn armrests.

proof_requests: Video: raise/lower the chair and show it holds height without sinking (gas lift test).
Video: demonstrate tilt/recline and any locking function; show it holds position.
Photos/video: underside of the seat and base/frame joints from multiple angles; include a shake/wobble test.
Video: roll the chair on the floor and test all wheels; test any brakes if present.
Photos: all upholstery sides and close-ups of seams/creases; confirm no stains under good light.
Photos/video: both armrests—show whether they adjust and confirm they are firm and not loose.
response.reason: The chair type is clear, but key value-determining functions (gas lift, tilt/lock, structural wobble, wheel performance, and hidden damage) are not shown in the witness report. Without those checks, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
